nodes.label: Ciclo de entrega aprobada
nodes.rationale: Cada bloque pasa por plan, aprobación, implementación, pruebas, revisión del diff y nueva aprobación para controlar alcance y reversión.

nodes.label: Minimización en la retención
nodes.rationale: Se prefiere inicialmente conservar el reporte completo doce meses y solo trazabilidad mínima después, porque reduce el tratamiento de datos, sujeto a validación jurídica y contractual.

nodes.label: Consulta processing huérfana
nodes.rationale: Al persistir solo jobid, una respuesta válida con id de reporte reutilizado deja provider_request_id nulo; el sincronizador espera y el monitor excluye la fila.

nodes.label: Node.js, Express, Sequelize and PostgreSQL Backend Stack
nodes.norm_label: node.js, express, sequelize and postgresql backend stack

nodes.label: Demo Data Production Guard
nodes.rationale: Demo fixtures are explicitly fictitious, load only into an empty user table, and are rejected in production to prevent unsafe use of public demo credentials or personal data.

nodes.label: Destructive Database Sync Guard
nodes.rationale: DB_SYNC_FORCE recreates database structures, so it is restricted to disposable local databases and blocked in production.

nodes.label: Secure Backend Environment Configuration
nodes.rationale: Backend environment files must contain only local credentials or secrets supplied through the environment's secure secret manager, and real personal data must not be used in development.

nodes.label: Versioned and Reversible Migrations
nodes.rationale: sequelize.sync() is not a substitute for a migration system, and the legacy Tusdatos schema script must become a versioned, reversible migration under CODE-00B.

nodes.label: Production Static Asset Hosting
nodes.rationale: vite preview is intended only for local review; production assets should be served through a static-file service with HTTPS, security headers, and an artifact rollback strategy.

nodes.label: Vite Public Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: Secrets must not be stored in VITE_* variables because Vite embeds those values in browser-delivered code.

nodes.label: CODE-00B Migration and Rollback Plan
nodes.rationale: Formal versioned migrations, backups, restoration, and rollback are deferred to CODE-00B; until then, destructive synchronization and legacy migration scripts require safeguards and manual review.

nodes.label: Fictitious Demo Data Policy
nodes.rationale: Demo data uses unmistakably fictitious identifiers and is restricted to disposable local databases because its passwords are public and the seed mode is unsafe for production.

nodes.label: Secret and Personal Data Hygiene
nodes.rationale: Environment files are excluded from Git, and secrets, tokens, production credentials, and real personal data must not be copied into documentation, fixtures, or tests.
